knowledge.title: Programming Language
knowledge.content: Python is the primary programming language used for AI development, backend engineering, automation systems, APIs, and SaaS platforms.

knowledge.title: Backend Framework
knowledge.content: FastAPI is the primary backend framework for building secure, high-performance, asynchronous APIs and backend services.

knowledge.title: Frontend Framework
knowledge.content: Next.js is used for building modern, responsive, and SEO-friendly web applications and dashboards.

knowledge.title: Containerization
knowledge.content: Docker is used for containerization, deployment consistency, and scalable application delivery.

knowledge.title: Caching
knowledge.content: Redis is used for caching, sessions, queues, background jobs, and performance optimization.

knowledge.title: Database
knowledge.content: PostgreSQL is the primary relational database used for scalable backend applications.

knowledge.title: Cloud
knowledge.content: Applications can be deployed to AWS and other supported cloud platforms depending on project requirements.

knowledge.title: Authentication
knowledge.content: Authentication systems support OAuth, JWT, secure login flows, and role-based access control.

knowledge.title: APIs
knowledge.content: REST APIs are the primary API style. GraphQL can also be implemented when appropriate for the project.

knowledge.title: AI Integration
knowledge.content: Applications can integrate with OpenAI-compatible models and vector databases to build AI chatbots, AI agents, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.

knowledge.title: Version Control
knowledge.content: Git-based workflows are used for source code management and collaboration.

knowledge.title: Architecture
knowledge.content: Solutions follow scalable backend architecture, modular code organization, secure APIs, and maintainable software engineering practices.

faqs.question: Which programming language do you use?
faqs.answer: Python is the primary programming language used for AI systems, backend development, APIs, and automation.

faqs.question: Do you use FastAPI?
faqs.answer: Yes. FastAPI is the primary backend framework used for high-performance APIs and backend services.

faqs.question: Do you use Next.js?
faqs.answer: Yes. Next.js is used for modern frontend development, dashboards, and web applications.

faqs.question: Do you use Docker?
faqs.answer: Yes. Docker is used for containerization and deployment.

faqs.question: Do you use PostgreSQL?
faqs.answer: Yes. PostgreSQL is the primary relational database used for backend systems.

faqs.question: Do you use Redis?
faqs.answer: Yes. Redis is used for caching, queues, sessions, and performance optimization.

faqs.question: Do you deploy on AWS?
faqs.answer: Yes. AWS deployment is supported where it matches project requirements.

faqs.question: Do you build REST APIs?
faqs.answer: Yes. REST APIs are the primary API architecture used in projects.

faqs.question: Do you support GraphQL?
faqs.answer: GraphQL can be implemented when it is the right fit for the project.

faqs.question: Do you build AI applications?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI chatbots, AI agents, automation systems, and AI SaaS applications are part of the services offered.
